name: 無重力護甲 Armor of Weightlessness (BMT)

description.value:
護甲（輕甲、中甲、或重甲），非普通（需同調）
這套護甲具有5發充能。穿着這套護甲期間，你可以用附贈動作消耗1發充能來用這套護甲，以自己爲目標施展以下法術之一：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.1B8U6kl0egesx3FK]{跳躍術 Jump}（1充能）或@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.GNvrHluGdgqD06wZ]{浮空術 Levitate} （2充能）。
這套護甲在每日黎明時分恢復[[/r 1d4 + 1]]發已被消耗的充能數。

This armor has 5 charges. While you wear it, you can use a bonus action to expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells from the armor, targeting yourself: @spell[Jump] (1 charge) or @spell[Levitate] (2 charges).

This armor regains [[/r 1d4 + 1]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Breastplate|PHB] (@item[Breastplate of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Mail|PHB] (@item[Chain Mail of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Shirt|PHB] (@item[Chain Shirt of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Half Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Half Plate Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Hide Armor|PHB] (@item[Hide Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Leather Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Padded Armor|PHB] (@item[Padded Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Plate Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Ring Mail|PHB] (@item[Ring Mail of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Scale Mail|PHB] (@item[Scale Mail of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Spiked Armor|SCAG] (@item[Spiked Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Splint Armor|PHB] (@item[Splint Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
  • @item[Studded Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Studded Leather Armor of Weightlessness|BMT])
